intro: Tilt the entire course to guide your golf ball through creative obstacles, avoid hazards, and sink the perfect shot across challenging levels.
description:
Discover a fresh take on mini golf where the course is just as important as the ball. Instead of swinging a club, you'll tilt the entire level to guide your golf ball through creative courses filled with ramps, moving platforms, narrow pathways, and clever obstacles.

Use gravity to your advantage as you carefully control the ball's movement, avoid dangerous hazards, and find the perfect route to the hole. Every level introduces new challenges that require precision, timing, and strategic thinking to master.

Easy to pick up but difficult to perfect, each course rewards careful control and experimentation. Learn how every tilt affects the ball's momentum and overcome increasingly complex layouts as your skills improve.

Can you conquer every course and become the ultimate master of gravity-driven mini golf?

Features:

Unique gameplay where you tilt the entire course instead of hitting the ball.
Creative levels filled with ramps, moving platforms, and challenging obstacles.
Physics-based gameplay that rewards precision and careful timing.
Increasingly difficult courses that test your skill and strategy.
Simple controls that are easy to learn and satisfying to master.
Relaxing mini golf experience with a fresh and original twist.
